answer: An AI-agent market can maintain a global counter k of identities ever admitted. Its contract atomically burns k+1 scarce settlement coins and increments k for each new identity. Aliases such as tundra, walnut and mirror face the same counter. A farm with n identities therefore pays at least n+1 coins for another. Splitting wallets cannot divide this per-identity charge; deleting history never lowers k, and pre-aging aliases in parallel requires paying every successive fee upfront.
